DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Isang mga kalikasang umaga po ah to the Chair and the Honorable Members of the Committee.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: With your permission, and with the Committee's kind indulgence, allow me to present the

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: key highlights of our proposed fiscal year 2027 budget and strategic priorities.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: For a more detailed discussion of these highlights, I respectfully refer the Honorable Members

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: to the printed copies that have been distributed for your reference.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: The DENR respectfully requests for a total budget of 28.04 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: This amount covers the DENR Central Office, our 17 regional offices, all staff and line bureaus,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: With an immense mandate covering 15.8 million hectares of classified forest lands and over

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: 36,000 kilometers of coastline, the Department is entrusted with a challenging, yet vital

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Our primary priority is translating this mandate into direct community impact.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Amid limitations in fiscal space, we commit to channeling our resources toward three highly

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: First, we are unlocking our natural capital to drive sustainable socio-economic development.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We are transforming the National Greening Program into a forest landscape restoration

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: approach focusing on priority landscapes such as the Sierra Madre Protected Landscape.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: For 2027, we aim to support community-based social enterprises, ensuring that we do not

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: merely plant trees, but restore biodiversity, strengthen ecosystem resilience, and create

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We are aggressively scaling up our land titling program.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Our goal is to issue up to 43,000 land patents in 2027, providing absolute tenure security

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: that unlocks vital economic capital for families and households.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: In the mining sector, we are driving towards a 2% mining GDP contribution by 2028.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We will maximize our mineral wealth by empowering small-scale miners through the Minahang Bayan Program

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: and fast-tracking critical mineral quadrangle mapping, balanced

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: strictly with rigorous regulatory compliance monitoring and enforcement.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Second, we are advancing a clean and healthy environment.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Reliable access to clean water is a fundamental right.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: For 2027, we are providing 124 million pesos in direct financial assistance to local water

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: to expand services to isolated and unserved barangays.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: On solid waste management, we continue to empower the local government units and provide them with technical assistance.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Furthermore, our implementation of the Extended Producer Responsibility Act

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: has already mobilized over 1,000 enterprises, diverting 244 million kilograms of waste packaging footprint.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: As part of this effort, we shall aggressively continue our revitalization of major urban waterways,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: particularly the Manila Bay, Pasig River system, and Laguna Lake.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Third, we are strengthening ecosystem integrity and climate resilience.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Through the Mines and Geosciences Bureau, we are operating a 24-7 geohazards operations center that sends direct,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: real-time threat advisories to LGUs to protect at-risk barangays.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We are specifically targeting our interventions to the 18 high-exposure

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: provinces identified in the National Adaptation Plan to support risk-informed planning.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Because ecosystems are our strongest natural defense, we are strengthening the active management

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: of our 121 legislated protected areas and our marine protected area networks.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Fundamental to all these priorities is the paradigm shift brought about by the PENCAS law. The department is currently enhancing its technical capacity and workforce to establish site-specific ecosystem accounts. By measuring the economic value of our environment, the ecosystem services, and the tangible benefits of conservation, we are enabling smarter, data-driven planning, programming, and budgeting.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: To conclude, Mr. Chair, Honorable Members of the Committee, financing the environment and natural resources is a strategic investment toward achieving nature-positive, climate-resilient, and sustainable Filipino communities and livelihoods. We seek your support in passing the budget. Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: Gaya ng requirements sa local government code at EIS system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Bakit po ito napayagan ng DNR?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pwede po bang i-explain ito dito sa committee?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Why this is not a violation of your mandate?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, yung pong tinutukoy ng FTAA yung pong sa Oceana Gold po kung di po ako nagkakamali.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Yung pong Oceana Gold when it was...

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: nag-expired na po siya, yung pong renewal niya ay umakyat pa po sa Office of the President.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: And it has gone through various process of securing po yung particularly yung FPIC including yung social acceptability requirement.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Kung meron po ngayon mga statement na the company is operating without public acceptability,

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Ang MGB na imbestigahan po yung mga allegations or yung mga facts na yun kung ito po ay may basihan na wala talagang nakuha yung mining company na social acceptability requirement.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Pero yung pong sinasabi ko lang po, yung pong FTAA actually has gone the first term of its 25 years and is working, it is now operating under the second term.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: And wala po kami ng mga...

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: na-receive na report na merong mga abuses na ginagawa ng mining company.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: But we will be ready to investigate po yung mga issues na non-acceptability ng community doon sa mining operation po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang malas ko siguro no dahil ako yung naka-receive ng report about this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: But ito na lang po ang hilingin ko sa DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pwede po ba yung DENR makapagbigay

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: sa atin ng data na nagpapatunay na kumpleto po sila ng requirements at hindi po sila lumabag doon or nagkaroon ng violation sa kanilang mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pangalawang kaso po, ganoon din po sa Tampakan, South Cotabato, kung saan nirenew at in-extend pa ang 18 years na FTAA No. 002 ng DENR at MGB,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: muli ring walang consultation at prior consent mula sa communities at LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ano po kaya ang accountability mechanisms ng DNR para sa ganitong mga renewal na lumalabag sa participatory requirements ng batas, especially sa IPRA?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Actually, itong meron pong consultation na dinadaanan po lahat yan, particularly kung meron na po silang existing na ECC, meron pong public consultation na dinadaanan yan.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: And so, with the indulgence of the committee, Mr. Chair, we will submit all these documents to the Honorable Congresswoman after this hearing, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you. Please submit to Congresswoman Ismula.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we will have a submission regarding Tampakan. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Just put a note na lang po, Mr. Chair, sa ating ginoong sekretary na kadalasan po kasi ang nangyayari kaya siya na-re-renew ng hindi na nagkakaroon ng konsultasyon dahil nagkaroon na siya ng unang approval.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: At nung nag-expire po siya, hindi po nila ito kinonsulta ang community ulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po ba sa patakaran ng ating IPRA, kinakailangan po na magkonsulta po ulit kung ito ay nag-expire na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: On waste management, ano ang hakbang ng DNR para masiguro na ang LGU waste management contractors ay dumadaan sa mahigpit na vetting process at hindi nagiging instrumento ng conflict of interest ng mga lokal na opisyal?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Meron po bang oversight ang DNR dito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Secretary, who will answer that question?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair, for the question.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: As we know, under the law, RA

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: The local government units have the responsibility when it comes to the waste management within their areas of jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Ang responsibility naman po ng DNR is to provide technical assistance and to educate ang ating mga local government units, mga barangay,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: on how we can assist in putting up the materials recovery facilities, in helping educate the people on segregation,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: and other aspects of the law.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: But pagdating po sa pag-engage ng private entity to do the waste management for the LGUs,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: wala po kaming mandato to really look into the particular, alam po nila, Congressman Erice being also involved in the LGU.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: So in that aspect, wala po kaming...

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Opinion or comment on this, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Sakali po, Mr. Chair, na naintindihan ko po kung sinasabi po ng ating ginoong sekretary na wala silang mandato dito, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Pero sakali po kayang may nai-report po sa kanila na ganito at pinapa-imbestigahan sa kanila, may action po ba silang ginagawa?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We call the attention of the local government unit at nakipag-ugnayan po kami.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Actually, with the local government units,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: with Waste, tuloy-tuloy po ang coordination namin sa kanila, our regional offices,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: particularly the EMB, are in coordination with the local government units on solid waste management, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I have one more question regarding waste management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: If the waste management provider's contract is up for renewal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: will we have another consultation with the community regarding the performance of the contractor?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Actually, that exercise is purely with the LGU, Mr. Chair, and we are not part of that process, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, it looks like you're teaching because when we consulted, the LGU itself told us that it's the DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: The statement of the Honorable Smula is that there has to be one primary...

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: in the renewal of contracts of the private entities,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: but it is within our mandate to monitor, for instance, sanitary landfills on compliance with the ECC conditions, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: So, the waste management providers are purely local.

segments.speaker: Rep. Edgar R. Erice
segments.text: If there's a complaint, just go to the DILG.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Last but not least, for waste management, what does the DENR do to ensure that waste pickers have the right compensation and protection according to the Occupational Safety and Health Standards?

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: And how do contractors monitor compliance?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: If I may defer to Assistant Secretary Noreen Ran of Enforcement, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
segments.text: What we're doing when it comes to this, in fact, with the RA 9003,

segments.speaker: DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
segments.text: it's prohibited for the settlers in our sanitary landfills.

segments.speaker: DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
segments.text: So, the employment of the employees in the area,

segments.speaker: DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
DENR Assistant Secretary Norlito A. Eneran
segments.text: This is purely an operation of our provider and LGU.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I'll go to the wider discussion of forest governance and community rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: The DENR announced 38 trillion pesos forest investments from 2027 to 2052,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: which is expected to provide work and livelihood to rural communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: In addition, the DENR released Department Administrative Order No. 2026-34

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Distribution of the Forest Management Bureau

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: of more than 1.18 million hectares of potential investment areas

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: through the Sustainable Forest Land Management Agreements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: I would like to know how much was allocated to monitoring SFMAs and forest investment portfolio packages in NEP 2027.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much Mr. Chair. I'd like to refer to the Forest Mansion Bureau Director Art Fadikella, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Good afternoon, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: Regarding the announcement of our distinguished congressman in our investment area,

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: it is true that we are dealing with 1.18 million hectares of potential investment area.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: We are offering this to investors and once we have the applications and we have provided the tenured instruments,

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: we are ready to ensure that they follow the regulations and the conditions provided by the DNR.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: Now, we have been given three Sustainable Forest Management Agreements

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: according to the Department of Administrative Order that has been issued.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: And when they implement the projects,

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: we will give them to the Department of Administrative Order, to our regional offices for monitoring of what they are doing.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: So, we will give the funds when the projects are ready.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, thank you first to FMB Director Art Fadikella.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Please proceed. Yes, we'll give you more time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair, this is the last time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: It looks like I didn't get the answer that I needed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: What I am asking is, if we have this kind of program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: what I just want to see is how much we have invested in NEP for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Budget, how much is placed there?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may defer to Usec Jonas Leones, who supervises the Forest Management Bureau.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: to the question of the Honorable Congresswoman,

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: since the program is still new,

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: few of our, few have been applying for the SFLMA.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: But even then, just to inform the Honorable Congresswoman

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: that we have already allocated for 2027 an amount of 60 million

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Jonas R. Leones
segments.text: for monitoring, compliance monitoring of these tenure holders that we have awarded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Thank you very much to our DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Before I proceed to the next interpellator,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: let me have an omnibus recognition.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We would like to acknowledge the presence of Deputy Minority Leader Kaka Bag-ao from Dinagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Next is Deputy Majority Leader Gil Acosta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Next is Vice Chair Cristina Talavera Lopez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Deputy Majority Leader Patrick Michael Vargas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then we have a Vice Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Vice Chair Isabel Sagarbarria over there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then Vice Chair Geesnell Yap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Senior Deputy Minority Leader Leila de Lima.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we have Vice Chair Ditse Tina Pancho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we have Representative Allan Ty.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we also have Representative Renee Louise Co.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And finally, Representative Elmer Catulpos, a new member of Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And also, a representative here, almost my seatmate, the former... our Deputy Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: we have here Bong Teves, Jr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Importante talaga ang DENR to Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Assistant Minority Leader Sarah Jane Elago is now with us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Deputy Majority Leader, Vice Chair, of course, Tevez has already been recognized.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Then my cousin, Representative Leo Rodriguez, the more handsome one.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Assistant Majority Leader Antonio "Tonio" Roman III.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Let us now proceed with the interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we are now back to the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we have here Congressman, our Deputy Speaker before.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Bong Tevez, the floor is yours.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Fellow Congressmen, members of the DNR, headed by Secretary Attorney Juan Miguel Cuna.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Before I ask question, meron ba rito ng representative from National Solid Waste Management Commission?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: The DNR chairs that commission and the representative Undersecretary Rodriguez is here, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Do you have a question already?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So we'll propound the question now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Every budget hearing that the National Solid Waste Management Commission is a separate office under the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: However, Mr. Chair, for the information of everybody, the Chairman of the Commission is the Secretary of the DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kaya po malaki ang ginagampanan ng DNR sa komisyong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang Environmental Management Bureau din po ng DNR ay may mandato na mag-monitor at mag-imporse ng environmental law kasama ang Republic Act 9003.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang ating po nga sekretary ngayon ay dati pong Undersecretary in charge of Solid Waste Management.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: That is why alam po niya ang problema dahil palagi ko tinatanong sa kanya regarding Republic Act 9003.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ang sabi niya po sa akin nung mga nakarang taon kanya na pong inaayos ang mga problema

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: sa mga waste management para hindi na magkaroon ng problema sa public health loan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I was there a while ago for the deliberation of the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: What is the topic of discussion there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Now, I am here for the deliberation of the DNR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: And last week, I gave a privileged speech and I said myself that the National Solid Waste Commission is inutile.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Because this law has been around for 25 years, we are always in Grade 2.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: It means that the flooding problem in our society in Metro Manila is not only the problem of the DPWH,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: but also the problem of the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: The problem is also the garbage that is being washed in the canals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Now, Mr. Chair, I would like to ask Secretary Cunha,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: what are your concrete plans to solve this garbage crisis which floods our nation every time a typhoon hits our country?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: As a Commission Chairman of the National Solid Waste Commission,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: what are your concrete plans to solve this garbage crisis which floods our nation every time a typhoon hits our country?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Secretary, please answer another privileged speech given by Congressman Bong Temes.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Actually, solid waste management has been a big issue for the last few weeks,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: particularly because of the heavy rains that we have been experiencing throughout the country,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: and particularly here in the National Capital Region, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: In fact, just to share with the body,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: the Executive Secretary called for a meeting last week,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: which I participated in along with MMDA and our other agencies, including DPWH,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: which talked about the problem of garbage,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: which is a big contributor in terms of the heavy flooding that we have been experiencing lately.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: The Commission, Mr. Chair, that you're referring to,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: It was also discussed in the Commission that maybe one of the things that we really need to pursue is our enforcement.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Because we are always asked when...

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: pagka meron mga proposals even way back more than 10 years ago,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: nung nag-uumpisa pa lamang mag-introduce sa mga LGUs ng ordinances that would ban single-use plastics,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: kung anong opinion po natin in the DNR.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: And yung sinasagot po natin is that,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: siyempre we support anything that would lessen any type of solid waste in circulation,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: pero palagay ko po ang mahalaga ay yung tamang pagtatapon lang po.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: So the proper waste disposal is the root cause of the contribution of solid waste dun sa flooding po natin.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: So enforcement, in fact, napag-usapan po namin nila SILG at MMDA last week

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: when the President was called for a briefing on the situation dito sa Metro Manila

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: At I think it's high time na magkaroon po tayo ng honest-to-goodness enforcement also,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: not just the LGUs, pati po kami at DILG,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: to ensure that the different local government units, particularly the barangay,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: take care of their areas of jurisdiction and ensure that proper solid waste management is observed.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Dahil ito pong nagiging problema talaga natin kung,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: at ano pang material po ang pinag-uusapan natin, whether it's plastics, whether it's anything else,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: if it's properly disposed of, we would not be experiencing what we are experiencing now, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: So, to your point, Mr. Chair, maybe the Commission needs to come up with better, more concrete policies

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: to ensure enforcement, the proper use of the materials recovery facilities,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: which are mandated by the law.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Which, admittedly, hindi pa po fully compliant lahat ng 42,000 barangays.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Meron pa rin po pagkukulang, or meron pong mga nakatayong mga MRF in certain LGUs,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: but which are not actually properly used.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Para lang for compliance sake, meron po silang nakatayong MRF.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Magkano po yung budget ng MGB dyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: And siguro, idugtong yun ah, in particular, alam ko, satellite office lang yung Dinagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: So, magkano po yung sa Caraga?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Dalawang item lang po, national at regional.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: I defer to Usec. Ana Teh of Finance.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: The budget for monitoring under strengthening mineral regulation services through enhanced enforcement is about 53.6 million, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: So, we await the figures to be given.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Can you proceed to the next question?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: I assume that you are getting the numbers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: However, ang gusto ko lang pong ipoint out that because an island where a lot of mining companies are present, like dinagat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: is considered as a satellite office, technically walang allocated na specific budget for monitoring.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Hindi part ng monitoring ninyo na kapag nag-i-inform kayo sa probinsya kagaya ng dinagat ng mga status ng mga mining companies,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: kung ito ay suspended, et cetera, ay hindi nyo idadaan sa Facebook.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, yesterday, August 25, because there has already been clamor for closing a very small area in Hibusong Island,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: What you did, ang ginawa po natin ay naglabas ng notice to the public, Sec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At ang notice to the public ay dinaan sa Facebook.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At doon po sa notice, ang sabi po ninyo ay kahapon lang po ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: hindi ko alam dahil ba ito ba dumudugtong sa budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: dahil may committee hearing tayo ngayon at may demand yung public to explain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Ang Facebook page po ay contrary to what is circulating online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: There is no approved mineral exploration in Hibusong Island.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero alam po ng mga taga-Hibusong, taga-Dinagat, at ninyo din na may pwedeng application ang East Coast Mining Corporation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At in fact, 10 years ago, sabi nyo, may suspension na ito noong 2014, suspension order noong 2014,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: kung saan, kung resuman din po ako at naitanong ko na din po ito, 2014 pa po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Ang threat ng operation ng East Coast Mining sa Dinagat Island, Sir,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: I'm sure, please don't respond to me by saying that there is no mining operation in Hibusong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Of course, everyday po nababantayan po yan ang mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At lagi pong may rally, kailang malungkot kapag ka-budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: itatanong namin ulit, ito pong suspension order, kailan po ito matatapos?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kasi ang commitment po sa akin noong mga dati pong secretary pa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Syempre mamalasing ka, sir, kasi maabutan ka, na ito po ay suspension order pa rin hanggang ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kailan po ito talaga madedeclare na area closed for mining,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: ilang beses na po din sa loob ng sampung taong ko sa Dinagat, bilang representative at governor din po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: ilang taon na din pong pinagdebatihan at naglabas na po ng study,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: ang DENR po, that it should not be open for mining operations because of the vulnerability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, there are more than 100 areas that was already declared by LGUs at mga sangguniang barangay po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: declaring it conservation areas for protecting the vulnerability of the island.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: So, ang tanong ko po, Sek, dahil wala po akong may tatanong sa budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: dahil satellite po ang, alin po doon sa budget nyo, para hindi po po pipilitan na Facebook,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, sir, itong suspension order nyo, wala pong notice at wala pong communication sa LGU at sa mga tagat mamamayan ng Dinagat, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Magpapasalamat lang ako kay Kong Dago, kasi kasama ko po siya nagpapainay sa issue na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero sadly, sir, sa isang maliit na isla, kagaya ng Hibusong na hindi po pwede magdepend sa Facebook,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: hindi po pwede ang notice nyo po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: sa amin to say that there is no expiration or as of September 18, 2014, has been suspended through a Facebook post.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Hindi ko rin po nakita si MGB Director, sir, to even visit Dinagat Islands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, I don't see anyone from there who visits the small island of Dinagat to update us on the status of mining application.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero magpapasalamat lang ako kay Usec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kasi sinalubong niya ako, Usec. Fragada.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At sinalubong niya po ako para sabihin na maybe we can expand even the discussion of Hibusong to go into the other mining applications who are marami din naman po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: So, sir, pakisagot naman, magkano po ang pwede mo nating asahan para po sa monitoring ng mining operations ng Dinagat na napaka, hindi naman po konti.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, I can say more than ten.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: On the aspect of the budget, I defer to Usec. Ana Teh of Finance.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: Mr. Chair, for Caraga, we have a budget of 12.29 million for the whole region.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So, there's no specific breakdown how much is dedicated for Dinagat Island because there's no PENRA yet in Dinagat Island.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: But, Mr. Chair, what we can do is that there's also a budget allocation.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: For other activities within the region which we can actually utilize to ensure that there's proper monitoring on the different environmental activities in the island, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: May I allow you to make a rejoinder?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: In fact, yun po ang magiging problema natin, Usec., dahil wala pong specific allocation for Dinagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Considering it's a very vulnerable island.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Napakarami pong areas that should be protected.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero po halimbawa, bonsai forest, may pending mining application sinuspending po ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Hindi rin po namin alam ano pong mangyayari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Asa po ba kami isasara ito dahil bonsai forest po siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Tatlo lang po ang bonsai forest sa buong Pilipinas kasama ang Dinagat Islands.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero hanggang ngayon may MPSA application po, Sec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At in fact, may declaration na ang DENR na sana po ay hindi matuloy ang mining dyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Dahilan po, ang threat sa amin, araw-araw, at nagkaka-declare lang po ng aming LGU ng State of Calamity

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: kasi 17,000 na po ang naapektuhan ng absence ng tubig.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kasi kung dito po ay baha ang issue, doon po ay wala po kaming tubig dahil sa sobrang init.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: At ang pinagbibintangan po kayo sa amin, na ang dahilan po ay dahil napuputol ang lahat ng puno sa aming mga bukid.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero kung lack of education and information,

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: wala po kaming makakausap kasi wala po kayong opisyal na pumupunta sa amin to monitor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Specifically, sir, can I ask that we talk about this?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: I will wait. I will not accuse you of anything yet.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero can I ask lang po, una po, can somebody go there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: And I can even accompany you, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Can somebody go there to inform the people what is really the status of Hibusong Island and the East Coast mining?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: And please don't tell us, we know that already, that there is no pending operation permit that was given.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pero hindi naman ang threat ay nag-uumpisa kapag may permit po, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kahit po yung pananakot lang na hala bukas ay magsasara na kami, ay magbubukas na kami, ay threat na mismo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: So, and that's the one. Can we go there?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Second, can the ending of the process be a declaration of closure of mining operation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Dalawa lang po muna, isa-isa, para hindi tayo masyadong demanding naman, sir, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Una po yung very small area. I think it's already less than 1,000 hectares na the area of Hibusong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Can we declare that area closed for mining?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pwede naman po, sir, hindi nyo nga pa-operate eh. Kahit may initial permit na kayo for East Coast.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you, Congresswoman Kaka. We'll let them answer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Are you going to close that mining company?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Second, who will go as early as possible to Dinagat Island?

DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: Yes, we committed, I committed to the good Congresswoman that we would go down and visit probably our head for enforcement or even myself to check out Dinagat Island.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: I am aware of the bonsai forest.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: I assure the good Congresswoman there will be no mining in that area, number one.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: Number two, for that particular island, we apologize if there was an announcement made through social media.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: But officially, I will make sure that the region comes up with a proper statement regarding the notice to the public.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: But to further her request, we're in the process of cleansing mining claims as well.

segments.text: I assure the good Congresswoman that we will take a look at the claims in the area and probably through the PENRO, we can assign someone specifically to address monitoring of mining areas, ma'am, para makita rin po natin kung ano nangyari.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada
segments.text: So that's why I can commit to her that after check-in, we can automatically close if need be.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Pwede po ba natin para lang po humupa ang kanilang galit at mag-guarantee na hindi po bubuksan ang Hibusong to any mining operation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Sir, hindi po totoong walang mining operation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kapag dinalaw po kayo ng East Coast Mining at i-attempt yung mga opisyal nyo ng cellphone, ano pong isipin ng mamamayan ng Hibusong?

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Tapusin na po natin yung Hibusong Island, sir, pati po ang bonsai forest.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Kasi napakaliit po niyang issue pero napakalaki po na implication ng mga errors na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: And I will really be conscious in monitoring, sir, kasi wala po kayong specific budget allocated for Dinagat on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arlene "Kaka" J. Bag-ao
segments.text: Thank you. That's the last point.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you, Chair. Magandang hapon po sa ating lahat. Thank you very much to the DENR family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: First of all, I would like to express my support to the concerns of Congresuman Kakabagaw being Dinagatnon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: However, I would like also to manifest that in fairness to DENR Region 13 we have a number of people affected by the mining operation in Lurito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, the newly designated OIC of MGB Caraga, Engineer Glenn Swante, visited personally the area

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: and then they have also conducted a hearing in the area with the people, including the newly designated OIC of Regional Executive Director Marites Ocampo and the in charge of the Satellite Office were there with me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, I would like Mr. Chair, for the record, to commend Yusec Mark because he is only one ticks away.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, para lang malinaw, Mr. Chair, isang sagot, isang tanong. Can the... as a reiteration to the issue raised by Congresswoman Kaka Bag-ao, can the DENR give an assurance and a commitment—dalawa na po iyan, commitment at saka assurance, kasi may magkaibang ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Na wala nang mangyayaring mining operation sa Hibusong.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we can give that assurance, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Can you also give an assurance and commitment na wala nang mangyayaring mining doon sa Bonsai area at sa watershed area na nireklamo ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Watershed area doon sa isang barangay sa Lurito.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We can give that assurance, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: These are considered protected areas or no-go zones, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Yung malinaw talaga, categorical. Walang mangyayaring mining doon sa area na yan.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Kasi Watershed yan at saka Bonsai Forest.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Watershed, Bonsai Forest at saka protected area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pagka minahan ng bayan, kamay-kamay lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pagka minahan ng bayan, dinedesignate naman sa proper area, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, may commitment na may SN Dinagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: But instead, no, it should be permanent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mayroon naman pong competent person na nandyan sa Dinagat ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: You can make it permanent, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: This person, the people there are regularly coordinating with the people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mahirapan po kayo doon sa 13 million na ano ninyo.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Actually, Mr. Chair, for the information of the body,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: there is a existing provincial environment office on Dinagat Island.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: So, siguro kailangan ng augmentation lang.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Nang funding in terms of monitoring for monitoring purposes, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Thank you with that. Pero, in relation to your budget, na-mention ni Secretary yung budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: nagtataka ako, bakit sa 22.9% of your budget is concentrated to the office of the Secretary?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Mr. Chair, thank you very much for the question.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Kaya, nakalagay po. Na, office of the Secretary, pero kasama po lahat ng regional offices doon under the office of the Secretary, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Just for the... And also, the bureaus except the two-line bureaus, MGB and EMB, that have their own separate budget, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I will take it as it is, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Nerisk ko lang yan, for the record, na based on your budget, almost 73% na sa office of the Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: gusto kong i-advance in po, that our Chairman, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Those who are always presiding now, Chairman of the Committee on Energy,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: binibilisan po namin yung mabilis na, ayong sariling kuryente act para mag-install na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Tapos, natapos na po namin yung Battery Energy Storage Systems Act, nasa sinit na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Are you ready? With the disposal of this equipment and materials?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung mga ma-install na solar rooftop with battery, after 10 years yan, the battery will be discarded kasi papalitan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Are they not ready to recycle that, or do we have recycling plants?

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Offhand, before I defer to Atty. Matias of the EMB, we have treatment storage and disposal facilities,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: TSD facilities kung tawagin po, that cater to these electronic waste and other waste.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: But to elaborate more, EMB Director Mike Matias, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi wala pa yung batteries made of salt dito sa atin.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: Actually, sir, as mentioned by the Secretary, meron po tayong mga TSD facilities na nga dito po sa atin and we are accrediting and registering po sila.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: But, sir, yung valid point po, not only kasi in terms of scale po, malalaki po ito.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: As you've mentioned, sir, yung mga solar panels po natin, they have been in existence.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: So, dapat po na magkaroon po tayo ng pag-aaral as to how we can properly dispose of these.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: Before yung end life po nitong mga...

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: Solar panels per se is not harmless.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
segments.text: Yung glass on top, yung filament sa ilalim, yung filament sa ilalim yun ang medyo may problema.

segments.speaker: EMB Director Michael Drake P. Matias
Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: But, Congressman Dagooc is asking you whether are you ready na mag-influx yung napakaraming lithium batteries.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kasi yung 10 years, hindi man, masyadong matagal yun.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ang iba, naka-install na yan eh.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: So, how do you cope up with that?

segments.text: It's an environmental nightmare kung saan-saan mo lang masipa ito sa kalsada, sa kanal, nakatiwangwang dun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mr. Cherno, naintindihan ko, mahirap po sagutin yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kaya nga, sabi ko kanina, in advance ko na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi, just imagine in Metro Manila, kahit 30% lang ng kabahayan dito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: saan mo, din, nakikita mo yung inaugurate ni Presidente, napakalaking mga battery storage facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Wala pa po tayong batas ngayon yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, in advance ko yan, pag-isipan na ninyo, dito sa budget ninyo, Mr. Sekretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: I will humbly request na i-consider ninyo, kasi mangyayari yan. And, kasi because of the high cost of electricity that we have now, kaya nagkaroon tayo ng mga batas na mapagaan yung ano, one is the sariling kurinti, kanya-kanya na tayong install.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, at malaki po ang trabaho na gagawin ng DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Now, no need to answer, kasi mahirap yun sagutin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Now, on the next point, Mr. Chair, may problema tayo, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: mga tao na nagtatrabaho in one of the mining companies in Dinagat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Napuntahan na nila, but until now, hindi po nasasahuran.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Can the Secretary, in the Secretary level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: assure this representation na while nagkaso yung mining company at saka yung outsource niya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ay mabigyan man lang ng kahit installment basis,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: yung salaries and wages ng mga nagtatrabaho?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi sa ngayon, wala. Napaka-unfair naman yun. Pinagtatrabaho nila yun.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We will request not only the regional office of MGB,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: but the central office to coordinate with this particular mining company, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: to assure that the workers are properly compensated.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ano ba 'yan, Cong. Dagooc? Pilipino ba 'yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi karamihan lang sa Surigao Mining, puro na Chinese eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kilala ni Secretary yung I don't want to mention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ang gusto ko lang mangyari, kasi nagtuturo na yung mining company na yung service provider niya ang dapat magbayad. Ngayon, kinasuhanan niya dahil hindi nagbayad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: My request to the Secretary is DENR's intervention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Na makausap to... Nakausap tong mining company na while nagkaso sila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: ay kahit mag-parcel payment muna sila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: kasi walang, hindi nakapagtrabaho yung mga tao doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Dahil doon nagtatrabaho sa mining. Kumita na sila. Hinakot na nila yung or.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, can the Secretary give an assurance for the intervention of DENR

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair. I will have Usec Mark coordinate with you to get the particular mining company so we can coordinate with them, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: With Usec Mark, sa experience ko sa kanya, alam ko this can be done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Kasi naanaw ko sa tao, naamiss ako doon sa kanyang, ano, 1 ticks away, 2 ticks away.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pag natanggap niya, inaaksyonan niya kagad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, I hope maraming Usec Mark sa DENR, kasi yung mga, yung mga ibang, mga ibang inaano mo, wala eh.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Sandali. Favoritism yan. Bakit yung taga-Siargao, one text away.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Kami sa Palawan, anim na buwan na, wala pang aksyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Hindi ka siguro nag-text, no? Hindi ka siguro nag-text, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Pero ako, pumunta doon yung MJB, pumunta doon yung RA Day, mga bagong appointment lang yun, mga bagong upo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ngayon, kung hindi ako makuntento, mag-text lang ako kay Usec Mark, bumalik naman doon eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Finally, Mr. Chair, gusto ko lang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Ipaabot yung pasasalamat to the Secretary through the USEC, through USEC mark and yung MJB Region 13, RA Region 13.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Yung mga ipa-follow up na lang nila dito na non-complying mining operators.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: Mayroon namang mga nag-operate na based on the report, substantially compliant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, wala lang tayong problema doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sergio C. Dagooc
segments.text: So, yung mga non-compliant, dapat may makita kami ni Kung Kaka na compliance.

segments.text: The Lone District of Ormoc, Congressman Richard Gomez, the fencing champion of Visayas.

segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: I sent you a letter regarding the Palumpon watershed problem, which we investigated last Congress.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: But it's too long to take it up here today.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: So please take a look at it and review that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: I think there's still a lot of problems going on with the watershed program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: And then, I want you, Mr. Chairman, Mr. Secretary, to take a look at illegal activities in our district.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: There are a lot of illegal logging happening.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: Illegal quarrying, illegal mining happening around my district.

segments.text: Ang tinitignan ko lang yung district ko, hindi ko tinitignan yung ibang distrito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: Kasi yun lang yung kino-cover ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: Just to let you know, Mr. Secretary, so that you'll know how much I care for the environment when I was mayor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez
segments.text: I closed all quarrying activities in Ormoc City.

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez

segments.text: permits, licenses, you cannot operate even

segments.speaker: Rep. Richard I. Gomez

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary for Field Operations and Line Bureaus Joselin Marcus E. Fragada

So, yun po muna para... Kasi ang importante po sa amin yung rehab. Kasi sa dami po nila dyan, you have to make sure that the rehabilitation is done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. May I defer to Yusek Anate of Finance. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the mandate of the DNR pertaining to flood mitigation activities or projects

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: are within the activities of watershed management.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So, we have a budget for watershed management under the budget of the Forest Management Bureau.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So, that would also include the NGP for the reforestation of about 147 million.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: We also have the water-related offices within the DNR, which includes the River Basin Control Office, and the... all the regional offices, and, of course, the National Water Resources Board and the Water Resource Management Office.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So, that's where the budget on flood mitigation falls, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay, thank you, ma'am. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Pero specifically, ma'am, yung sa National Flood Management Framework para doon sa study na kung saan titignan kung yung mga future flood control projects, kailangan naka-align kung saan siya dapat gagawin.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may defer to the Executive Director of the National Water Resources Board, the attached agency of the DNR.

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: Yes, with the permission of the Secretary.

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: So, this flood management framework was prepared by the DNR through the Water Resource Management Office, as well as the River Basin Control Office of the DNR.

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: Ang plan mo dito, Mr. Chair, is all the flood control plans of the DPWH should be coherent doon po sa master plan that were prepared by the DNR, yung mga river basin master plans. So, yung po yung ginagagawin natin ngayon to closely coordinate with the DPWH which we are already doing, Mr. Chair, with the DPWH na maging complementary po yung mga nature-based solutions ng DNR with the planned gray infrastructures of the DPWH, Mr. Chair. And based on the plan also is subject to review po, no? And coordination, yung mga flood control plans po ng DPWH, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Sir, anong status ngayon ng National Flood Management Framework? Kailan ito matatapos at masasubmit sa DPWH?

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: Yun pong flood management framework, Mr. Chair, ay na-prepare na po.

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: I think we just have to seek the clearance of the Secretary for his final review. May na-prepare na po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay. Mr. Chair, kasi yung concern natin, hundreds of billions of pesos yung project ng DPWH, especially for flood control, yung mga projects. Yung budget ba ng DNR para doon sa mga staff na gumagawa para sa framework na yan ay sapat ba for 2027?

segments.speaker: NWRB Executive Director Sevillo D. David Jr.
segments.text: For 2027, I think we have to refer to you.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we have allocated 278 million pesos for integrated water resource management and operations.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So that would include operationalization of the water resource management office and water-related projects.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: We're also supporting the water resource utilization section within our regional offices,

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: although it's a minimal amount of 52.9 million pesos.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: But on the river basin, we're also providing support of 21 million for the sustainable operations.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: So, and we have another 28 million for what Director Bill mentioned about scaling up nature-based solutions.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: Well, of course, it's not sufficient even in terms of really making sure the monitoring.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: But we will, we agree that we will prioritize.

segments.speaker: DENR Undersecretary Analiza Rebuelta-Teh
segments.text: We have identified 18 principal or major river basins to... to focus on, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay, thank you, ma'am. Thank you, Mr. Chair. Another thing, sa Jensen, nung tumama yung magnitude 7.8 na lindol,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: napagalaman namin na a year before nangyari yun,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: nagsumite na ng report si PHIVOLCS sa LGU na kung saan merong 38% sa barangay ng GenSan may liquefaction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Yung concern ko sa MGB, yung sa geohazard mapping, paano siya ma-merge or ma-integrate yung liquefaction? Kasi with our experience, pag nagbigay yung PHIVOLCS doon sa LGU, hindi nami-merge yung data sa geohazard mapping nila. Hindi naka-layer. So, magkaiba yung data na natatanggap at saka yung sa geohazard mapping. Ngayon, paano siya makaka-comply yung mga bagong building permits at saka yung zoning ng CLUP? Dadalawa yung basis nila. Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DENR Acting Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna
segments.text: We'd like to defer to Dr. Karlo. The assistant director of MGB.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary. I'd like to respond. As a geologist, we're implementing the Department Administrative Order 2000-28 in which all infrastructures, whether government or private, should conduct an engineering, geological, and geo-hazard assessment as an additional requirement for the issuance of the ECC.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: So, essentially, before you construct a building, you should know the physical conditions, if it's liquefaction-prone, if it's flood-prone, or maybe if it's landslide-prone.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: So, basically, you map out all of these geo-hazards. So, it's not just simply superimposing the liquefaction because liquefaction and volcanic-related hazards are the mandates of the Philippine Institute of Volcanology. But in the same way, identifying the faults, and that's also perform the fevals. But on the side of the MGB, DNR, that's flooding and landslide, as well as what we call the karst, and to a certain extent, coast.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: But regardless of the mandate, it is important in the DNR admissive order that all of these hazards are looked into by the private entity.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: So, the process is the private entity would hire a private geologist to produce an engineering, geological, and geo-hazard assessment, after which the DNR MGB would review that document as to whether the document is able to address this hazard and design a particular infrastructure according to the hazard.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: So, it's not just simply mitigating, but also adapting the structure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay. Mr. Chair, yung concern lang,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: yung sa geo-hazard mapping ba ng DNR, kasama na ang liquefaction doon?

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: Yes po. That's why po, in the geo-risk hazards hunter,

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: these maps are integrated so that the end user would be able to make use of all of these maps po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Hindi kasi yung concern namin, nalimbawa sa DPWH, yung sabi ng DPWH, hindi magkakaroon, nang future, kailangan may concordance ng DNR, yung mga future projects, especially related to flood control. Pero kung hindi nakasama yung liquefaction map doon sa basis ni DNR, possible pa rin na may mangyayaring masama kung sakaling may liquefaction na hindi siya na-factor in doon.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: Tama po yan. That's why po, importante po sa isang building, or whatever infrastructure that these hazards are integrated,

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: unfortunately po for Gensan, it is underlain, a large portion of it is underlain by Lahar.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: That's the reason why kapag naglindolo, matindi po yung ground shaking po niya.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: And also, liquefaction is one of those, what you call these consequences of strong ground shaking.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: That's why po, sa mga ganyang klaseng mga lugar, importante yung na-integrate yan sa design.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: I mean to say, yung liquefiable, for example, na layer, ay bina-bypass po ng foundation ng isang building mo.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: But I believe po, because of the DNR business order, that is actually a requirement for all these private entities to integrate all of these hazards before implementing that project po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung concern ko, Mr. Chair, kung may way ba na ma-merge yung data na yan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: DNR, ma-merge yung data na yan para pag nagbigay ng certification or concurrency DNR, kasama na yun, na-consider na yung ano, kasama yung data, nang liquefaction.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: Actually po, the municipalities at lahat po ng mga provincial, they can actually superimpose all of these maps.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: Dahil lang po yan ay available po nga po sa Hazards Hunter.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: But of course, on the part of the DNR MGB, we are also offer our assistance to review all of the CLUP that also integrates this kind of hazard.

segments.speaker: MGB Assistant Director Karlo L. Queaño
segments.text: So as to be able to all these local governments to understand, and how to actually make use of those maps in the context of their land use plans.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elmer V. Catulpos
segments.text: Okay, that's all, Mr. Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: FMB Director Arturo E. Fadriquela
segments.text: Meron po tayong definition, working definition ng critical watershed. Ang sinasabi po, it is based on PD 705. It is a drainage area of a river system supplying existing and proposed hydroelectric power, irrigation works, and domestic water facilities needing immediate protection and rehabilitation. So yung mga identified watershed, yung mga watershed na bumabagsak po sa definition na ito, na supporting existing and proposed hydroelectric power, irrigation works, and domestic water utilities, ay nakaklasify po natin siya as critical watershed.
