segments.text: Last on the list is Cong. Sheen Gonzales

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Sek, maiksi na lang po yung sasabihin ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: To the MGB Director, Director Heradez,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: I will just direct my question with the permission of our Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: I will just direct my question to the MGB Director, Director Heradez.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kilala niyo po ba ang Mount Sinai mining sa Homonhon, pa rin po ito?

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Mount Sinai po, opo. Yes po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: May I ask, ano po ang status nito ngayon?

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Ang Mount Sinai po ay meron ding approved MPSA number 351-211.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: But na-approve po din po yung Declaration of Mining Project Feasibility ngayon noong 2011.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: However, since 2013, nasa under care and maintenance po ang MPSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Balik po tayo sa Cambayas Mining.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kilala niyo po ba yung may-ari ng Cambayas Mining?

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Dalhin mo na sa kanya lahat.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Ang Cambayas Mining po, sila po yung mga naunang mining company na nag-operate po for chromite sa Homonhon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Do you have any knowledge sino may-ari nito, Director?

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Ang may-ari po niyan is the late engineer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Are you sure of this po?

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Yes po, as per our record po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Under cambayas, as I have said a while ago, in-split, naging dalawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang tanong ko po dito, nung in-split po siya, naging dalawa yung MPSA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Bakit po nagkaroon ng tatlong operators?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Operator ng agreement sa isang MPSA.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Nung mga naunang implementation po natin when the mining act was issued po, we allowed po yung ganong system.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: We can approve a number of operating agreements po from one MPSA.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: However, nagkaroon na nga po ng mga problems with regards to a single MPSA operated by several or a number of operators.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Kaya po nung 2021 or 2022, we issued a policy of prohibiting more than one.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: One operator, one MPSA po ang nilabas ng DENR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Siguro, alam nyo na po yung sinasabi ko sa inyo, Director, kahit saan po natin tingnan ito sa batas, wala po tayong makikita na pwede po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Anyway, Section 96 of Republic Act 7942, also known as the Mining Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Violation of the terms and condition of the permits or agreements shall be a sufficient ground for cancellation of the same.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ang ganito pong pagkakataon, nakikita niyo, siyempre nasa inyo naman po yung bola, kayo yung mag-iimbestiga, kayo yung makakakita sa ground,

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: as I have said kanina, na pwedeng puntahan nyo doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Ano po ang maikukumit nyo dito?

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Kahapon po, nag-meeting po yung tungkol sa Homonhon mining operation.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Ang agreement po ay we will conduct a general assessment of the mining operation po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi kung assessment mo isang taon.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Rapid po. Mabilis po na assessment.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: Then we commit that after that assessment immediately, we will have a concrete action on the situation po doon.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: What is your definition of immediate? The good congressman is asking.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: If I may, papalapit na po tayo sa plenary. Sana hindi na po ito umabot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Kasi we all know that the good chairman is doing his best for this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Alam niyo na po siguro ang ibig sabihin ko dito. I'm very serious about this.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Ayun. Larry, please see him tomorrow, the good congressman.

segments.speaker: MGB Director Larry M. Heradez
segments.text: investigation and the action afterwards po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Before, it is before the plenary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Can we get, can I get the result of that before the plenary?

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Salamat, Mr. Chair, sa supporta. Maraming salamat po sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: That would be all. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Jose C. Alvarez
segments.text: Suspend the briefing for a while while awaiting for our chairwoman to arrive.

segments.text: Special request para materminate na natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Christopher Sheen P. Gonzales
segments.text: Again, good evening sa ating lahat.

segments.text: This is my third and final round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you po for working with us in protecting po, of course, our environmental resources, and the best way that we could express our gratitude is to, we can reciprocate it by making sure you have the resources that you need to be able to perform your mandate better.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
